ms.report:
TL;DR
You can find all the specifications here is this repository folder: https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/tree/spec/docs/whitepaper/src

Details
While working on this milestone we resolved the following tasks:
1. Researched and recorded the lottery specification -- https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/14/files
2. Researched the cryptography needed for the protocol implementation -- the source text is closed for now. (attached pdf in the last monthly report: "Aggregation and Verification for Handel in Spectrum Setting")
3. Protocol design -- https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/blob/spec/docs/whitepaper/src/system-design.tex
4. System model -- https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/blob/spec/docs/whitepaper/src/system-model.tex
5. Implemented Handel aggregation protocol -- https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/17/files (a part of the 3rd milestone)

Also there are several drafts that will be merged very soon (under review now):
1. STF draft - https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/16
2. Improved lottery draft - https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/18

ms.promise: (A) At the end of this stage, we have a piece of software built on top of Spectrum Networking layer that implements the protocol described in the second milestone + integration tests that checks the ability of the network to reach consensus on a set of test transactions.
ms.criteria: (A) The consensus layer is implemented according to the specification from the second milestone. Protocol features and properties are covered with unit tests. Also, a runnable integration test demonstrates a simple network reaching a consensus on a set of test transactions.
ms.report:

✔️ Scalable signature aggregation crypto (based on MuSig and optimized for tree-based overlays). Links:
· https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/23
· https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/30

· https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/25
· https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/19
✔️ Discovery behavior + IT tests. Responsible for peer discovery. Links:
· https://github.com/spectrum-finance/spectrum/pull/34
✔️ Diffusion behavior + IT tests.  Responsible for nodes synchronization.
